title: Forward simulation of the inlining pass assembled from four per-obligation lemmas
intent: Reduce the semantics-preservation theorem of the RTL inlining pass to the four named obligations of a forward simulation (symbol environment, initial states, final states, and the step-simulation diagram), each proved as its own lemma, so the headline theorem is a five-line glue.
also_known_as: forward-simulation record discharged field by field

children.name: transf_initial_states
children.statement:
Lemma transf_initial_states:
  forall st1, initial_state prog st1 -> exists st2, initial_state tprog st2 /\ match_states st1 st2.
children.closed_by: function_ptr_translated, (Genv.init_mem_match TRANSF), symbols_preserved, sig_function_translated, match_stacks_nil, Genv.initmem_inject

children.name: transf_final_states
children.statement:
Lemma transf_final_states:
  forall st1 st2 r,
  match_states st1 st2 -> final_state st1 r -> final_state st2 r.

children.name: step_simulation
children.statement:
Theorem step_simulation:
  forall S1 t S2,
  step ge S1 t S2 ->
  forall S1' (MS: match_states S1 S1'),
  (exists S2', plus step tge S1' t S2' /\ match_states S2 S2')
  \/ (measure S2 < measure S1 /\ t = E0 /\ match_states S2 S1')%nat.
children.closed_by: induction on the step relation, then one case per RTL instruction; each case by tr_funbody_inv plus the match_stacks_* / agree_* / Mem.inject lemmas

applicability.goal_shape: A simulation theorem forward_simulation (semantics prog) (semantics tprog) for one compiler pass (more generally, a goal whose head is a record or inductive with a small fixed set of fields).
applicability.use_when: The target is a forward_simulation with a fixed set of obligations (symbol environment, initial states, final states, simulation diagram) that can each be stated and proved independently, and the simulation relation plus a well-founded measure can be fixed up front.
applicability.avoid_when: The obligations share substantial auxiliary state that would have to be re-derived in each lemma (then the lemmas are not self-contained); the simulation relation is still unstable while the diagram is being proved; the record has many or unknown fields.

consequences: The move creates one obligation per field of the simulation record, each closed by a named lemma. Three are small (3, 17, 8 lines); the step-simulation diagram is the real content (351 lines) and needs a well-founded measure (measure, lines 860-865). The glue eapply forward_simulation_star fixes the diagram shape (a plus/star simulation with a measure), so the simulation lemma must be stated in exactly that shape; if the diagram cannot be put in that shape the glue does not apply. A failure mode: a pass whose step-simulation needs the same large machinery as its initial/final lemmas ends up with one giant lemma rather than four.
